summary: Iteration 8 validates the full INKED admin dashboard + business management system. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_8_admin.py (17 tests, 17/17 PASS). Coverage: (a) admin login returns user.is_admin=true and demo user is_admin=false; (b) /api/admin/stats RBAC — 401 no-token, 403 non-admin, 200 admin; (c) stats payload has users, artists, bookings{total,paid,refunded,cancelled}, revenue{gross,commission_earned,artist_earnings,pending_payouts}, commission_pct=15; (d) /api/admin/users returns bookings_count per user and no password_hash; (e) POST /api/admin/users/{id}/toggle-admin flips is_admin both ways; (f) /api/admin/artists returns pending_earnings/pending_count/paid_out_total/bookings_count; (g) POST /api/admin/artists creates, PATCH updates fields including blocked_dates (verified via /api/artists/{id}/availability returning day_blocked=true and blocked_dates list), DELETE hard-deletes when no bookings; (h) POST /api/bookings -> POST /api/payments/checkout-session (mock URL) -> POST /api/payments/mock-confirm marks paid AND creates earnings_ledger with commission exactly 15% of (deposit+service_fee) — verified via /api/admin/commissions where every row commission==round(gross*0.15) and artist_net==gross-commission; (i) /api/admin/bookings supports payment_status filter and attaches user_email (lowercased) + user_name; (j) POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/refund on paid booking marks payment_status=refunded and status=cancelled and ledger status=refunded; (k) POST /api/admin/payouts creates payout, marks ledger paid_out, second call with no pending returns 400, list includes new payout; (l) cancel booking with far-future date returns status=cancelled, payment_status=refunded. FRONTEND (Playwright, 390x844, Expo web): (1) Admin tab is GATED — appears in bottom nav only when logged in as admin@inked.dev; demo@inked.dev shows Discover/Bookings/Messages/Profile only (no admin link). (2) Admin dashboard renders admin-title + all 4 stat cards (stat-users=29, stat-artists=6, stat-bookings=86, stat-paid=21) + all 4 revenue rows in PHP (rev-gross=₱60,900, rev-commission=₱9,135, rev-artist-earn=₱51,765, rev-pending-payouts=₱17,255) + all 6 nav tiles (nav-users, nav-artists, nav-bookings, nav-payments, nav-commissions, nav-payouts). (3) All 6 sub-screens open successfully: Users (29 rows with 29 toggle-admin-{id} buttons), Artists (6 rows with edit/toggle-active buttons + admin-artists-add), Bookings (filter-all/paid/unpaid/refunded — 21 refund-{id} buttons on paid filter, 0 on unpaid filter as expected), Commissions (3 comm-row-{id} — Kai/Mara/Diego with GROSS/COMMISSION/ARTIST NET PHP values), Payments (31 pay-row-{id} rows), Payouts (new-payout-btn opens modal with pick-artist-{id} options, payout-note input, confirm-payout, modal-close). (4) Payout create E2E — before=4 rows, tapped CREATE PAYOUT, picked Kai Nakamura, entered note, confirmed -> after=5 rows (persistence confirmed). (5) Artist edit blocked-dates: opened Ash Rowe edit, typed 2029-04-15 into e-block-date, tapped e-block-add -> e-block-2029-04-15 chip appeared, tapped save-artist-edit -> saved (redirect to /admin/artists). (6) Demo customer regression — demo@inked.dev signed in, Discover shows 6 artist cards + featured, tapping artist-card-{id} loads /artist/{id}, book-session-button loads /book/{id} STEP 1 OF 3 SELECT DATE & TIME with date/time/hour chips — booking flow unchanged. Stripe still runs in mock-checkout mode (STRIPE_API_KEY not real).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L926-974 admin_stats correctly nests bookings + revenue objects and returns commission_pct from env (defaults 15) — matches PRD spec.
server.py L1140-1173 admin_create_payout marks all pending ledger entries for the artist as paid_out atomically and rejects with 400 when no pending — spec-correct.
server.py L1076-1102 admin_refund_booking returns 409 if not paid, sets status=cancelled AND payment_status=refunded, and updates ledger status=refunded in same request — correct.
server.py L766-808 mock_confirm computes commission via compute_split(deposit + service_fee) — total includes home-service fee so commission is 15% of full gross, matching spec.
server.py L1395-1427 startup backfill of commission_amount/artist_earnings + ledger for existing paid bookings is idempotent via $setOnInsert on booking_id key.
(tabs)/_layout.tsx L54-61: admin tab gated by href: isAdmin ? '/(tabs)/admin' : null — Expo Router hides the tab entirely for non-admins (confirmed on demo user).
(tabs)/admin.tsx L44-51 shows ADMIN ONLY placeholder if user.is_admin false (defense-in-depth), and useEffect loads stats via adminApi.stats(token).
admin/bookings.tsx L108 refund button only rendered when item.payment_status === 'paid' (verified on unpaid filter — 0 refund buttons).

admin/payouts.tsx create modal disables confirm when no artist picked and only lists artists with pending_earnings>0 (pick-artist-{id} count matches pending artists = 2 initially, correctly reflecting business rules).
admin/artist-edit/[id].tsx L155-181 blocked dates: input + add button + removable chips; save calls PATCH /admin/artists/{id} with blocked_dates array — verified via backend + UI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all admin flows + demo regression verified on mobile 390x844
